name: context-and-currency
note: A period and a quantity, and the currency and scale they imply.

name: wrapped-magnitude-across-pages
note: A magnitude that wrapped onto the next page finishes the number before it.

name: wrapped-date-headers
note: A month/day head and the year beneath it join into one date.

name: distant-year-not-attached
note: A year too far below the head does not finish it.

name: phone-not-negative
note: An area code is a reference, never a bracketed negative.

name: citation-year
note: A year reached through a citation names a law, not a period.

name: period-year-survives
note: Period language speaks for the year after it.

name: superscript-footnote
note: A mark set smaller than its page is a superscript, not a negative.

name: identifier-label-scope
note: A cue condemns only the number after it.

name: number-mark
note: A number mark names the number beside it.

name: number-mark-answers-only-next
note: A mark answers for the next number, not the sentence.

name: unsupported-prose
note: A bare integer in a sentence, with nothing saying it measures.

name: figure-survives-prose
note: A figure written as a figure survives in prose.

name: isolated-cell
note: A number in its own cell is never unsupported.

name: modifier-next-line
note: A modifier on the next line speaks for the number before it.

name: bare-year-in-prose
note: A bare year in prose stays a value.

name: page-furniture-footer
note: A running footer is furniture, not content.

name: period-caption-survives
note: A period caption repeating on every page must stay readable.

name: row-twice-on-page
note: A row printed twice on one page is content.

name: bare-figures-column
note: A column of bare figures does not convict itself.

name: exhibit-column
note: An exhibit column is refused whole.

name: ascending-ages-stay-values
note: A column that only ascends is not a list.

name: numbered-column-beside-figures
note: A marker leads prose; a cell whose neighbour is a figure leads nothing.

name: inline-enumeration
note: An inline enumeration is refused.

name: footnote-block
note: A footnote block and its indicators are refused.

name: bracketed-negative-survives
note: A bracketed negative in a column survives the footnotes.

name: bracketed-percent-not-marker
note: A bracketed percentage is never a marker.

name: shared-footnote
note: One note answers every mark pointing at it.

name: full-size-bracket-not-mark
note: A full-size bracketed figure is not a mark.

name: form-number
note: A form number is a reference, not a value.

name: fragmented-figure
note: A fragmented figure is reported rather than guessed.
